static bool isPrime(int n) {
    if (n <= 1)
        return false;
    if (n <= 3)
        return true;
    if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0)
        return false;

    for (int i = 5; i * i <= n; i = i + 6)
        if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0)
            return false;

    return true;
}
static bool nextPermutation(vector<int> &nums) {
    int n = nums.size();
    int i;

    for (i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (i < 0) {
        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end(), greater<int>());
        return false;
    }

    //find another num from the left that > arr[i] and swap them
    for (int j = n - 1; j > i; j--) {
      if (nums[j] > nums[i]) {
        swap(nums[i], nums[j]);
        //sort last i+1 numbers to get next smallest permutaion
        sort(nums.begin() + i + 1, nums.end(), greater<int>());
        return true;
      }
    }
    //If no satisfying another number found, reverse the right part
    reverse(nums.begin()+i+1, nums.end());
    return false;
}
